name: mediasense
description: Let Claude listen to audio and watch video: transcribe voice messages, podcasts and recordings, and summarize or edit TikTok, YouTube or Instagram links.
long_description: mediasense gives Claude ears and eyes for media: voice messages, podcasts, recordings, meetings and videos. Point at an audio file, or paste a TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, X or Vimeo link (or point at a file) and ask Claude to summarize it, explain what happens, find when something is said, cut out filler words and pauses, or make subtitles. Everything runs on your computer: the video is downloaded, the speech is transcribed in ~99 languages with a timestamp for every word, and key frames are picked at scene changes. The first use downloads the speech model (~500 MB) and, if needed, FFmpeg (~70 MB). Tip: also add the mediasense skill (Settings → Skills) so Claude uses it for every video link.

tools.name: understand_media
tools.description: Summarize, explain or answer questions about a video/audio link or file (transcript + key frames + metadata).

tools.name: check_job
tools.description: Get the result of long work that replied 'still working'.

tools.name: transcribe
tools.description: Speech to text with a timestamp for every word.

tools.name: read_transcript
tools.description: Read a transcript, optionally a time range or per-word times.

tools.name: search_transcript
tools.description: Find every time a word or phrase is said.

tools.name: plan_edit
tools.description: Preview cuts: phrases, passages, filler words, silences, time ranges.

tools.name: render_edit
tools.description: Write the edited file and/or EDL, FCPXML and re-timed subtitles.

tools.name: export_transcript
tools.description: Export subtitles and text: SRT, VTT, TXT, CSV, JSON.

tools.name: place_audio
tools.description: Insert an audio clip into a video at a timestamp (mix, duck or replace).

tools.name: watch_video
tools.description: Key-frame contact sheets with what is said in each shot.

tools.name: get_frame
tools.description: One video frame at a given time.

tools.name: media_info
tools.description: Duration, resolution, fps and streams of a file.

download_folder.title: Download folder
download_folder.description: Where videos downloaded from links are kept (and reused).

cookies_browser.title: Browser cookies for blocked sites (optional)
cookies_browser.description: Leave empty. If a site refuses downloads, type firefox (or chrome, edge, brave) to use your browser's login.
